000428: typedef struct CPreprocessorDefinition CPreprocessorDefinition;
000429: struct CPreprocessorDefinition
000430: {
000431:     // An identifier, optionally followed immediately by a function-like
000432:     // parameter list parsed under the same rules as a source `#define`.
000433:     String8 name;
000434:     // The replacement list, taken verbatim: an empty value defines an
000435:     // object-like macro that expands to nothing, the way `-DNAME=` does. A
000436:     // caller that wants the `1` a valueless `-DNAME` means must spell it.
000437:     String8 value;
000438: };

000446: 
000447: typedef struct CPreprocessorOperation CPreprocessorOperation;
000448: struct CPreprocessorOperation
000449: {
000450:     // The operand without its -D/-U prefix. Definitions retain their first
000451:     // '=' so forwarding consumers preserve `-DNAME`, `-DNAME=`, and values
000452:     // containing later '=' characters exactly.
000453:     String8 operand;
000454:     CPreprocessorOperationKind kind;
000455: };

000470: typedef struct CPreprocessOptions CPreprocessOptions;
000471: struct CPreprocessOptions
000472: {
000473:     // Authoritative when macro_operation_count is nonzero. The separate
000474:     // arrays below remain the compatibility path for existing callers: their
000475:     // definitions are applied first, followed by their undefinitions.
000476:     CPreprocessorOperation* macro_operations;
000477:     CPreprocessorDefinition* definitions;
000478:     String8* undefinitions;
000479:     String8* include_paths;
000480:     String8* system_include_paths;
000481:     String8 source_path;
000482:     Target target;
000483:     TargetDataLayout data_layout;
000484:     u32 macro_operation_count;
000485:     u32 definition_count;
000486:     u32 undefinition_count;
000487:     u32 include_path_count;
000488:     u32 system_include_path_count;
000489:     u32 expansion_limit;
000490:     u32 include_depth_limit;
000491:     CPreprocessDialect dialect;
000492:     bool disable_external_includes;
000493:     // GNU-as sources use `#` for line comments, so a `.S` run treats a `#`
000494:     // line whose word is no known directive as a comment instead of an
000495:     // error; conditionals, defines and includes keep their meaning.
000496:     bool assembly_comment_lines;
000497:     u8 reserved[2];
000498: };

000500: typedef struct CSymbolTable CSymbolTable;

000502: // The spelling space of every preprocess result begins with this fixed
000503: // prelude, so tokens synthesized after preprocessing (static-assert
000504: // wrappers, lowering-internal constants, C23 respells) can reference
000505: // well-known spellings at compile-time-known offsets.
000506: #define C_SPELLING_PRELUDE_TEXT "_Static_assert();._Bool_Alignas_Alignof_Thread_local010.0f"
000507: enum
000508: {
000509:     C_SPELLING_STATIC_ASSERT = 0,
000510:     C_SPELLING_STATIC_ASSERT_LENGTH = 14,
000511:     C_SPELLING_LEFT_PARENTHESIS = 14,
000512:     C_SPELLING_RIGHT_PARENTHESIS = 15,
000513:     C_SPELLING_SEMICOLON = 16,
000514:     C_SPELLING_DOT = 17,
000515:     C_SPELLING_BOOL = 18,
000516:     C_SPELLING_BOOL_LENGTH = 5,
000517:     C_SPELLING_ALIGNAS = 23,
000518:     C_SPELLING_ALIGNAS_LENGTH = 8,
000519:     C_SPELLING_ALIGNOF = 31,
000520:     C_SPELLING_ALIGNOF_LENGTH = 8,
000521:     C_SPELLING_THREAD_LOCAL = 39,
000522:     C_SPELLING_THREAD_LOCAL_LENGTH = 13,
000523:     C_SPELLING_ZERO = 52,
000524:     C_SPELLING_ONE = 53,
000525:     // "0.0f"; length 3 spells "0.0".
000526:     C_SPELLING_FLOAT_ZERO = 54,
000527:     C_SPELLING_PRELUDE_LENGTH = 58,
000528: };
000529: 
000530: BUSTER_CT_CHECK(sizeof(C_SPELLING_PRELUDE_TEXT) - 1 == C_SPELLING_PRELUDE_LENGTH);

000533: // spelling space, and the commit-on-demand arena owning that space. Behind
000534: // one pointer because CPreprocessResult travels by value through the whole
000535: // parse and lowering surface — growing that struct taxes every call.
